faqs.title: Are the cars displayed on the site reliable?
faqs.content: of course we only have verified cars

faqs.title: What types of cars do you offer?
faqs.content: We offer sedans, SUVs, hatchbacks, coupes, convertibles, wagons, vans and pickups — both new and used.

faqs.title: How can I search for cars on your website?
faqs.content: Simply use our search bar to enter location, brand, price range, year, mileage, fuel type and car type.

faqs.title: Do you provide assistance for first-time car buyers?
faqs.content: Yes, we guide you through the process and help find suitable financing.

faqs.title: What should I consider when buying a car?
faqs.content: Location, condition, size, amenities, and future development plans.

faqs.title: How long does the car-buying process typically take?
faqs.content: Usually 3 to 6 days, depending on various factors.

faqs.title: What happens if I encounter issues with the car after purchase?
faqs.content: We offer post-purchase support to address any concerns promptly.

faqs.title: Do you offer cars in specific cities?
faqs.content: Yes, we have listings in Seoul, Busan, Incheon, Daegu and other cities.

faqs.title: Can I sell my car through your website?
faqs.content: Absolutely, we provide services for selling cars as well.

faqs.title: What if I need help understanding legal aspects of car purchase?
faqs.content: Our team can provide basic guidance and recommend legal professionals if needed.

faqs.title: How can I make the payment?
faqs.content: you make the payment through a dealer!

faqs.title: Are there any additional fees for using your services?
faqs.content: No, our services are free for buyers. Sellers pay a commission upon successful sale.

faqs.title: Is there an option for installment payments?
faqs.content: Yes, we offer installment payment plans for certain cars. Please inquire for more details.

faqs.title: Is my payment information secure on your website?
faqs.content: Yes, we use industry-standard encryption technology to ensure the security of your payment information.

faqs.title: Can I make payments online through your website?
faqs.content: Yes, you can securely make payments online through our website's payment portal.

faqs.title: What happens if there's an issue with my payment?
faqs.content: If you encounter any issues with your payment, please contact our support team for assistance.

faqs.title: Do you offer refunds for payments made?
faqs.content: Refund policies vary depending on the circumstances. Please refer to our refund policy or contact us for more information.

faqs.title: Are there any discounts or incentives for early payments?
faqs.content: We occasionally offer discounts or incentives for early payments. Check our promotions or contact us for current offers.

faqs.title: How long does it take for payments to be processed?
faqs.content: Payment processing times vary depending on the payment method used. Typically, credit/debit card payments are processed instantly

faqs.title: Are there penalties for late payments?
faqs.content: Late payment penalties may apply depending on the terms of your agreement. Please refer to your contract or contact us for details.

faqs.title: What should buyers pay attention to?
faqs.content: Buyers should check and decide whether the car they want to buy is actually suitable!

faqs.title: How can I determine if a car is within my budget?
faqs.content: Calculate your budget by considering your income, down payment, and potential mortgage payments. Our dealers can assist you within your budget.

faqs.title: What documents do I need to provide when purchasing a car?
faqs.content: You'll typically need identification, proof of income, bank statements, and any necessary loan documentation. Our team will guide you through.

faqs.title: What factors should I consider when choosing a used car?
faqs.content: Check the year, mileage, accident and service history, fuel type, and have the car inspected before buying.

faqs.title: Can I negotiate the price of a car?
faqs.content: Yes, you can negotiate the price of a car. Our dealers will assist you in making competitive offers and negotiating terms with the seller.

faqs.title: What are some red flags to watch out for when viewing cars?
faqs.content: Watch out for signs of structural damage, water damage, mold, outdated systems, and undesirable neighborhood conditions.

faqs.title: Do you provide assistance with car inspections?
faqs.content: Yes, we can recommend reputable inspectors and accompany you during car inspections to identify any potential issues.

faqs.title: How long does it typically take to find the right car?
faqs.content: The timeframe varies depending on your preferences and market conditions. Our dealers will work diligently to find the right car as quickly as possible.

faqs.title: What are the advantages of buying a car through a dealer?
faqs.content: Real estate dealers provide expertise, negotiation skills, and guidance throughout the buying process, ultimately saving you time and hassle.

faqs.title: What happens if I change my mind about a car after making an offer?
faqs.content: Depending on the terms of the offer and the stage of the transaction, you may have options to withdraw your offer.

faqs.title: What do I need to do if I want to become a dealer?
faqs.content: If you really decide to become an dealer, you should read our terms and conditions and contact the admin!

faqs.title: What qualifications do I need to become a car dealer?
faqs.content: Complete pre-licensing course, pass licensing exam, meet state requirements.

faqs.title: How do I find clients as a new car dealer?
faqs.content: Build network, use online/offline marketing, join reputable brokerage.

faqs.title: What are some effective marketing strategies for selling cars?
faqs.content: Use social media, online platforms, networking events, and direct mail.

faqs.title: How do I handle negotiations with buyers and sellers?
faqs.content: Develop strong negotiation skills, understand market trends, represent client interests.

faqs.title: What should I do to stay updated with market trends and changes?
faqs.content: Attend industry events, follow automotive news, participate in training.

faqs.title: How do I handle difficult clients or situations?
faqs.content: Approach with professionalism, empathy, and patience. Listen actively, address issues collaboratively.

faqs.title: What tools and technologies should I utilize as a car dealer?
faqs.content: Use CRM software, virtual tours, digital marketing tools, and mobile apps.

faqs.title: How do I ensure compliance with car sales laws and regulations?
faqs.content: Stay updated with laws, attend education courses, consult legal professionals.

faqs.title: What strategies can I use to grow my car sales business?
faqs.content: Build relationships, provide exceptional service, seek referrals, and continuously improve skills.
